greeting: Tower Warden Construct on comms. Stage 2: Trials of the Makers. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Ascent. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I put fear on a schedule. It keeps missing meetings.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Trial of Creation: Build what the Void destroys.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Trial of Creation: Build what the Void destroys; Trial of Destruction: Unmake Void corruption; Trial of Preservation: Protect the innocent at cost to self. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Face challenges designed to test the Progenitors' successors. Immediate move: Trial of Creation: Build what the Void destroys.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 2 resolved: Trials of the Makers. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Memories in Stone.
rumor: Arena chalk marks now redraw themselves after every storm.
People keep repeating one clue from Trials of the Makers: 'Trial of Transcendence: Choose the greater good over personal desire'.
If your shadow starts giving tactical advice, charge it rent and keep walking.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn in the tower is maintenance hour. Security patterns are predictable.
dialog.time_noon: Noon rotations overlap. Expect stacked encounters and less recovery time.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk shadowing in tower arenas hides projectile tells. Keep spacing.
dialog.time_night: Night floor clears are endurance checks. Pace your resources.

party_reactions.kade: Tower Warden Construct sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.

party_reactions.twist: Tower Warden Construct talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.
